title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression, quality gating and eval metrics integrations
author: Priya Sharma
description:
Motivation: Add an eval-harness CI hook that runs prompt-set regression checks and quality gating as part of PR validation. This hook integrates additional evaluation metrics (BERTScore and Rouge-L) and exposes threshold configuration per-prompt-set so teams can opt into strict gating. The goal is to catch regressions early (accuracy/quality drops on curated prompt sets) and fail CI when predefined gates are violated.

What this PR does: - Adds a reusable GH Actions workflow and a Python CI hook that downloads the eval artifact, runs the configured prompt-sets, computes metrics, and compares to baselines. - Integrates BERTScore and Rouge-L in addition to existing token-level checks. - Adds a lightweight local test runner and unit tests for the hook. - Exposes gating config via eval-harness/configs/ci_gates.yaml and supports per-repo overrides. - Adds docs and a runbook for oncall and SRE when the quality gate blocks merges.

Checklist: - [x] Implement CI hook and workflow - [x] Metric integrations (BERTScore, Rouge-L) - [x] Config file + default thresholds - [x] Unit tests and a small e2e smoke test - [x] Docs & runbook - [x] Linear ticket references (ENG-4521, ENG-4603)

Testing notes: The CI workflow is gated behind a conditional and runs in the eval-harness matrix for PRs touching runtime/eval or docs. Local test runner can be invoked with `python -m eval_harness.ci.run --prompt-set smoke` and `pytest tests/eval_harness`. I added a small fixture to cache downloaded baselines to reduce flakiness.

Rollout plan: Deploy the workflow in a canary mode for the redwood repo for 48h, monitor false-positive rate via a custom metric (ci.eval-gate.false_positives), then flip the gating flag to mandatory for protected branches. Ops runbook added at docs/dev/ci.md.

Related: ENG-4521 (prompt regression gating), ENG-4603 (metric integrations), SUP-1023 (customer reported regression alert).

release_notes: Add eval-harness CI hook for prompt-set regression checks, integrate BERTScore and Rouge-L, and introduce configurable quality gating. Enables per-prompt-set failure gating in CI to catch regressions earlier.
notes_for_oncall: If the eval-gate blocks merges, follow docs/dev/ci.md runbook: check last run details in the GH check, inspect per-prompt-set deltas, consult baseline artifact build job. For unexpected spikes open SUP ticket and tag oncall-sre.
